Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure is a three-part illustration of a bouncing light pulse seen from two reference frames. Part (a) shows a side view of a space shuttle above a magnified inset: inside a rounded frame an astronaut in an orange suit, labeled Astronaut, floats beside an analog clock reading delta tau, while a Light source drawn as a yellow burst and a Receiver sit side by side beneath a Mirror, with teal arrows carrying the pulse straight up and straight back down over the bracketed vertical distance D. Part (b) shows the same apparatus from outside: three dashed-outline snapshots of the cabin run left to right, and a purple path labeled s goes diagonally up from the source in the left snapshot, labeled Beginning event, to the mirror in the middle snapshot, then down as a second segment s to the receiver in the right snapshot, labeled Ending event. Brackets below give the horizontal shifts L = v delta t / 2 and L, and a standing figure on a tan ground plane is labeled Observer on Earth beside a clock reading delta t. Part (c) reduces the picture to bare geometry, an isosceles triangle whose two slanted sides are each labeled s, divided by a vertical altitude D into right triangles with bases L = v delta t / 2 and L, with s = sqrt(D squared + L squared) written above. Drawing the same pair of events twice makes the two path lengths directly comparable, which is what forces the two recorded times apart.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Toggle between astronaut frame and Earth frame: learner switches the named observer view; the light path changes from straight up-and-down distance 2D to two diagonal segments 2s while the clocks display delta tau and delta t; the frame dependence of elapsed time becomes clear.
- Slider for shuttle speed v: learner increases or decreases horizontal motion; the cabin snapshots spread apart, L grows, the diagonal light path lengthens, and delta t increases relative to delta tau; the geometric origin of time dilation becomes visible.
- Button sequence through beginning, mirror reflection, and ending event: learner steps the pulse through the three events; the same event markers light up in both apparatus and triangle panels; the shared events explain why the two observers can disagree about path length but not about what happened.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax University Physics, chapter 38: Relativity

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

The pulse travels only the vertical distance 2D, so this frame records the proper time Δτ = 2D/c — the shortest possible round-trip time.'); }); L.text('Astronaut').move(52, 292).font({ size: 12, family: 'sans-serif' }); // Clock Δτ var clk = L.group(); clk.circle(44).center(90, 345).fill('#fff').stroke({ color: '#333', width: 2 }); for (var i = 0; i < 12; i++) { var a = i * Math.PI / 6; clk.line(90 + 18 * Math.sin(a), 345 - 18 * Math.cos(a), 90 + 21 * Math.sin(a), 345 - 21 * Math.cos(a)) .stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1 }); } clk.polygon('90,345 102,330 96,348').fill(TEAL); clk.line(90, 345, 90, 327).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 2 }); L.text('Δτ').move(122, 336).font({ size: 16, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }).fill('#0a7'); // Mirror L.rect(56, 9).center(220, 105).fill('#bde0fe').stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.5 }); L.text('Mirror').move(246, 76).font({ size: 12, family: 'sans-serif' }); // Vertical light path (up and down, teal arrows) L.line(212, 335, 212, 112).stroke({ color: TEAL, width: 2.5 }); L.polygon('212,108 207,122 217,122').fill(TEAL); L.line(228, 112, 228, 335).stroke({ color: TEAL, width: 2.5 }); L.polygon('228,339 223,325 233,325').fill(TEAL); // Source burst + receiver var burst = L.group(); burst.star = burst.polygon('220,326 223,335 232,335 225,341 228,350 220,344 212,350 215,341 208,335 217,335') .fill('#ffd60a').stroke({ color: '#e0a800', width: 1 }); burst.css('cursor', 'pointer'); burst.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Light source', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip) .on('click', function () { showPopup('Light source & receiver', 'A single pulse leaves the source, bounces off the mirror, and returns to the receiver beside it. Both observers agree on these three events — they disagree only about how far the light traveled and how long it took.'); }); L.rect(20, 12).move(244, 336).fill('#ccc').stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1 }); L.text('Light\nsource').move(196, 366).font({ size: 11, family: 'sans-serif' }); L.text('Receiver').move(268, 356).font({ size: 12, family: 'sans-serif' }); // D bracket L.line(292, 110, 292, 340).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.5 }); L.line(286, 110, 298, 110).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.5 }); L.line(286, 340, 298, 340).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.5 }); L.polygon('292,104 287,116 297,116').fill('#333'); L.polygon('292,346 287,334 297,334').fill('#333'); L.text('D').move(300, 218).font({ size: 14, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }); // Photon dot (left panel) var photonL = L.circle(12).fill('#ffd60a').stroke({ color: '#e0a800', width: 2 }).center(220, 330); var eventRingL = L.circle(26).fill('none').stroke({ color: '#ff5d00', width: 3, opacity: 0 }).center(220, 330); /* ─────────── RIGHT PANEL (b): Earth frame, dynamic ─────────── */ var R = draw.group(); var frameBorderB = draw.rect(560, 330).move(345, 60).radius(14).fill('none') .stroke({ color: '#ffb703', width: 5, opacity: 0 }); var caption = draw.text('').move(360, 500).font({ size: 13, family: 'sans-serif', weight: 'bold' }); function renderRight() { R.clear(); var b = state.beta, Lp = Lpx(), g = gamma(); var xB = 360, yBase = 250, yTop = 95, cabW = 150, cabH = 175; var P0 = [xB + 75, yBase - 15], P1 = [xB + Lp + 75, yTop + 18], P2 = [xB + 2 * Lp + 75, yBase - 15]; R.text('(b) Earth frame — the cabin moves, the path is diagonal').move(360, 40) .font({ size: 13, family: 'sans-serif', weight: 'bold' }); // three dashed cabin snapshots for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { var cx = xB + i * Lp; R.rect(cabW, cabH).move(cx, yTop).radius(10).fill(i === state.step ? '#eef3fb' : '#e8e8e8') .stroke({ color: '#444', width: 1.5, dasharray: '7,5' }); R.rect(34, 8).move(cx + 58, yTop + 10).fill('#bde0fe').stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1 }); // mirror R.circle(12).center(cx + 30, yBase - 8).fill('#ffd60a').stroke({ color: '#e0a800', width: 1 }); // burst R.rect(18, 10).move(cx + 44, yBase - 12).fill('#ccc').stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1 }); // receiver R.circle(16).center(cx + 100, yBase - 8).fill('#fff').stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.5, dasharray: '3,2' }); // clock } // purple light path R.polyline([P0, P1, P2].map(function (p) { return p[0] + ',' + p[1]; }).join(' ')) .fill('none').stroke({ color: PURPLE, width: 3, linejoin: 'round' }); var m1 = [(P0[0] + P1[0]) / 2, (P0[1] + P1[1]) / 2], m2 = [(P1[0] + P2[0]) / 2, (P1[1] + P2[1]) / 2]; R.text('s').move(m1[0] - 18, m1[1] - 10).font({ size: 15, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }).fill(PURPLE); R.text('s').move(m2[0] + 10, m2[1] - 10).font({ size: 15, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }).fill(PURPLE); // dashed altitude D at middle snapshot R.line(P1[0], P1[1], P1[0], yBase - 15).stroke({ color: '#555', width: 1.5, dasharray: '5,4' }); R.text('D').move(P1[0] + 6, (P1[1] + yBase) / 2 - 8).font({ size: 14, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }); // L brackets R.line(P0[0], yBase + 22, P1[0], yBase + 22).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.2 }); R.line(P0[0], yBase + 17, P0[0], yBase + 27).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.2 }); R.line(P1[0], yBase + 17, P1[0], yBase + 27).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.2 }); R.text('L = v Δt / 2').move((P0[0] + P1[0]) / 2 - 34, yBase + 30).font({ size: 12, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }); R.line(P1[0], yBase + 22, P2[0], yBase + 22).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.2 }); R.line(P2[0], yBase + 17, P2[0], yBase + 27).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 1.2 }); R.text('L').move((P1[0] + P2[0]) / 2 - 4, yBase + 30).font({ size: 12, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }); R.text('Beginning event').move(P0[0] - 55, yBase + 52).font({ size: 11, family: 'sans-serif' }); R.text('Ending event').move(P2[0] - 45, yBase + 52).font({ size: 11, family: 'sans-serif' }); // formula R.text('s = √(D² + L²) → Δt = γ Δτ').move(560, 62).font({ size: 14, family: 'serif' }).fill('#333'); // Observer on Earth var ox = 600, oy = 415; var obs = R.group(); obs.polygon('420,470 780,470 750,395 450,395').fill('#e9e2d0').stroke({ color: '#c9bfa5', width: 1 }); obs.circle(16).center(ox, oy - 52).fill('#c98d5e').stroke({ color: '#555', width: 1 }); obs.rect(20, 40).move(ox - 10, oy - 44).fill('#6a994e').stroke({ color: '#446', width: 1 }); obs.line(ox - 5, oy - 4, ox - 8, oy + 26).stroke({ color: '#555', width: 6, linecap: 'round' }); obs.line(ox + 5, oy - 4, ox + 10, oy + 26).stroke({ color: '#555', width: 6, linecap: 'round' }); obs.css('cursor', 'pointer'); obs.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Observer on Earth', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip) .on('click', function () { showPopup('Earth frame', 'From Earth the cabin slides sideways during the round trip. The pulse must cover the two diagonal segments 2s > 2D. Since light speed is the same in every frame, the Earth clock must record a longer elapsed time: Δt = γΔτ.'); }); R.text('Observer on Earth').move(470, 415).font({ size: 12, family: 'sans-serif' }); // Earth clock Δt R.circle(30).center(700, 425).fill('#fff').stroke({ color: '#333', width: 2 }); R.polygon('700,425 712,412 706,428').fill('#0a7'); R.line(700, 425, 700, 408).stroke({ color: '#333', width: 2 }); R.text('Δt').move(722, 414).font({ size: 16, family: 'serif', style: 'italic' }).fill('#0a7'); // photon + event highlight var pts = [P0, P1, P2]; var p = pts[state.step]; R.circle(24).center(p[0], p[1]).fill('none').stroke({ color: '#ff5d00', width: 3 }); R.circle(9).center(p[0], p[1]).fill('#ffd60a').stroke({ color: '#e0a800', width: 2 }); caption.text('Δτ = 2D/c = 2.00 Δt = γ·Δτ = ' + (2 * g).toFixed(2) + ' (γ = ' + g.toFixed(3) + ', v = ' + b.toFixed(2) + 'c)'); } /* ─────────── photon in left panel follows the same event ─────────── */ function renderLeftPhoton() { var pos = { 0: [220, 330], 1: [220, 105], 2: [220, 330] }[state.step]; photonL.center(pos[0], pos[1]); eventRingL.center(pos[0], pos[1]).attr({ opacity: 1 }); } function updateFrameHighlight() { frameBorderA.attr({ opacity: state.frame === 'astro' ? 1 : 0 }); frameBorderB.attr({ opacity: state.frame === 'earth' ? 1 : 0 }); document.getElementById('frameAstroBtn').className = state.frame === 'astro' ? 'active' : ''; document.getElementById('frameEarthBtn').className = state.frame === 'earth' ? 'active' : ''; } var stepText = [ 'Event ①: the pulse leaves the source. Both frames agree this event happens — they will disagree about the journey length.', 'Event ②: reflection at the mirror. In the astronaut frame the pulse has gone straight up distance D; on Earth it has climbed the diagonal s = √(D² + L²).', 'Event ③: the pulse returns to the receiver. Same two endpoints, but 2s > 2D, so with one light speed the Earth frame must record Δt = γΔτ > Δτ.' ]; function renderAll() { renderRight(); renderLeftPhoton(); updateFrameHighlight(); document.getElementById('demoNarration').textContent = (state.frame === 'astro' ? 'Astronaut frame: path length 2D, proper time Δτ. ' : 'Earth frame: path length 2s, dilated time Δt = γΔτ. ') + stepText[state.step]; } /* ─────────── controls ─────────── */ function update_speed(v) { state.beta = v; renderAll(); } function toggle_frame(f) { state.frame = f; renderAll(); } function trigger_event(s) { state.step = s; renderAll(); } renderAll(); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
